div.head: II Cn 84.5
div.ab: Á sy Godes nama ecelice gebletsod, ⁊ lof him ⁊ wuldor ⁊ wyrðmynt symle æfre to worulde!
Á sy Godes nama ecelice gebletsod, ⁊ lof him ⁊ wuldor ⁊ wyrðmynt symble æfre to weorulde!
Sit nomen eius benedictum in uitam ęternam, et laus ei, gloria et honor pariter in secula seculorum!
A[a] sy Godes nama ecelice gebletsod, ⁊ lof him ⁊ wuldor ⁊ wyrðmynt æfre to worulde. Amen.
A sy Godes nama ecelice gebletsod, and lof him and wuldor and wyrðmynt symle æfre to worulde.
Immer (Aber B) sei Gottes Name ewiglich gesegnet, und Lob ihm und Preis und Ehre immer stets in Ewigkeit!
Ever (But, B) be God's name blessed eternally, and praise to him and glory and honour always and forever!
May the name of God be eternally blessed, and to Him be praise and glory and honour for ever and ever. Amen.
May God’s name be eternally blessed, and may there always be praise and glory and honor to him forever throughout the world.
